svg.title: Scenario 3: Enemy Turn — Goblin Attack Reduced by Warrior's DefendBuff

g.text: Scenario 3: Enemy Turn — Goblin Attack Reduced by Warrior's DefendBuff
This is the enemy phase of the same executePlayerTurn() call as Scenario 2.
Warrior (SPD=30) already defended — DefendBuff is active (turns=2, defenseBoost=+10).
Now: Goblin (SPD=25) acts and hits a hardened Warrior.
Same user action that triggered Scenario 2.
Shown here for continuity — this enemy phase
happens in the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior phase: defend() ran, DefendBuff applied.
(Warrior HP reduced by only 5 — DefendBuff visible)
